# stalwart_spam_classifier (Data Source)

Configures the spam classifier model, training parameters, and auto-learning settings. This singleton object always exists: creating the resource adopts the current server settings and destroying it only removes the resource from state.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `hold_samples_for` (Number) Duration to hold training samples for
- `id` (String) Always `singleton`.
- `learn_ham_from_card` (Boolean) Whether to automatically learn ham messages from senders in the user's address book.
- `learn_ham_from_reply` (Boolean) Whether to automatically learn ham messages that are replies to messages sent by the recipient.
- `learn_spam_from_rbl_hits` (Number) Number of DNSBL servers that list the sender to auto-learn as spam
- `learn_spam_from_traps` (Boolean) Train as spam messages sent to spam trap addresses
- `min_ham_samples` (Number) Minimum number of ham samples required for training
- `min_spam_samples` (Number) Minimum number of spam samples required for training
- `model` (Attributes) The spam classifier model to use. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--model))
- `reservoir_capacity` (Number) The capacity of the training sample reservoir
- `train_frequency` (Number) Frequency to train the spam classifier

<a id="nestedatt--model"></a>
### Nested Schema for `model`

Read-Only:

- `feature_l2_normalize` (Boolean) Whether to L2-normalize feature values in the spam classifier
- `feature_log_scale` (Boolean) Whether to apply sublinear scaling to feature values in the spam classifier
- `indicator_parameters` (Attributes) Hyperparameters for the indicator features in the FTRL-CCFH model (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--model--indicator_parameters))
- `parameters` (Attributes) Hyperparameters for the FTRL-FH model (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--model--parameters))
- `type` (String) Variant discriminator.

<a id="nestedatt--model--indicator_parameters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `model.indicator_parameters`

Read-Only:

- `alpha` (Number) The alpha parameter for the FTRL-Proximal algorithm
- `beta` (Number) The beta parameter for the FTRL-Proximal algorithm
- `l1_ratio` (Number) The L1 regularization parameter for the FTRL-Proximal algorithm
- `l2_ratio` (Number) The L2 regularization parameter for the FTRL-Proximal algorithm
- `num_features` (String) The number of parameters (2^n)


<a id="nestedatt--model--parameters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `model.parameters`

Read-Only:

- `alpha` (Number) The alpha parameter for the FTRL-Proximal algorithm
- `beta` (Number) The beta parameter for the FTRL-Proximal algorithm
- `l1_ratio` (Number) The L1 regularization parameter for the FTRL-Proximal algorithm
- `l2_ratio` (Number) The L2 regularization parameter for the FTRL-Proximal algorithm
- `num_features` (String) The number of parameters (2^n)
